items.title: Bob Watts Interview, 1963-02-28
items.q: I was with Henry Boyden's orchestra.

ctx.x: I think Handy's mother was Mother Richards in the church or something. Oh, I see.

Well, now, I, uh, when I was in Lorton, Oklahoma, I was in Lorton, Oklahoma on a job at the Rock Tavern there. I just remember what year it was, but anyway, I was with Henry Boyden's orchestra. We had seven pieces and we played every night except Sunday, I think. And we used to make trips up to Tulsa in Oklahoma City, see, you know, on our off nights, you know. And we was broadcasting them, 15 minutes every evening on the radio for this rock tavern, but we played, see, nightly. And I went, I visited a holiness…
